jobs.title: Staff Applied Scientist, Location Intelligence
jobs.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Every parcel ends at a door. Where that door is, where a courier can park, and which way they walk in decide whether a handover takes seconds or minutes, and whether anyone ends up at the wrong place at all. Most of that never shows up on a map. Relay sees the last mile through couriers' own devices: GPS traces from live deliveries that show where they park, which entrance they use and how long each handover takes. Turning those traces into a trusted picture of the real last mile is the foundation the rest of our Science builds on. Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered.
